summary.text: Dennis Powers is a Republican state representative from Jacksboro representing Tennessee House District 36 (Campbell, Union and part of Claiborne Counties), a member of the 107th through 114th General Assemblies. He chairs the House Private Acts Committee.

paragraphs.text: Powers was born on September 14, 1953, and is an insurance agent who attended LaFollette High School and earned a B.S. in business administration from the University of Tennessee.

In the House he has served as Majority Caucus Vice Chairman in the 110th General Assembly and as vice-chair of the Republican Caucus, and he sits on the Calendar & Rules, Commerce, and State & Local Government committees.

His page lists community service including past president of the South Campbell County Rotary Club, a role on the Campbell County Habitat for Humanity board, and volunteer work at LaFollette Medical Center.
